summary: Tested BUG FIX 1 (Modules tabs equal width + glider coverage) and BUG FIX 2 (Activities card equal heights) plus all regressions at 6 viewports. BUG FIX 2 fully passes. BUG FIX 1 passes at desktop/tablet (1440/1024/768) but FAILS at mobile widths (414/390/360) — Phase 1 and Phase 2 tabs are not equal width because `white-space: nowrap` makes the Phase 2 text intrinsically wider than Phase 1; `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` only distributes free space and does NOT equalize columns when min-content differs. As a side effect this also causes horizontal overflow at 360px (scrollW=376 > clientW=360). All 16 prior regression tests pass.

ui_bugs.issue: At viewports <=520px (tested 414, 390, 360), the two tabs are NOT equal width. Phase 1 tab width=153-160px, Phase 2 tab width=192px (delta 32-39px, way over the 2px tolerance). The .modules__tab-glider therefore does NOT cover the active tab cleanly (e.g. at 390px on Phase 1: glider.right - tab.right = 11px overshoot; on Phase 2: tab.right - glider.right = 17px shortfall). Root cause: `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` distributes only the FREE space equally; with `white-space: nowrap` on the tab buttons, each column's min-content equals its intrinsic text width, which differs between Phase 1 and Phase 2. The @media (max-width: 520px) block sets `.modules__tabs { width: 100% }` but does NOT override the columns to use `minmax(0, 1fr)` and does not allow the longer text to shrink. Suggested fix: change `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` to `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))` (forces equal columns) AND either shrink/wrap Phase 2 label on narrow viewports or reduce font-size further (e.g. use a shorter label like 'Phase 2 (C1)' below 520px) to prevent horizontal overflow.

document.documentElement.scrollWidth=376 vs clientWidth=360 — 16px horizontal scrollbar appears. Caused by the unshrinkable Phase 2 tab label inside .modules__tabs at 360px viewport. This breaks the 'no horizontal overflow at 360' regression requirement.

action_items: Fix .modules__tabs at viewports <=520px: change `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` to `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))` so columns equalize regardless of text length.

To eliminate the 360px horizontal overflow, additionally either (a) reduce .modules__tab font-size / padding further at <=400px, (b) allow tab text to wrap (remove `white-space: nowrap` at narrow widths), or (c) use a shorter label such as 'Phase 2 (C1)' below 520px.
After the fix, re-run viewport audit at 414/390/360 confirming abs(t1.width-t2.width) <=2, abs(glider.left-active.left) <=7, abs(glider.right-active.right) <=7, and scrollWidth==clientWidth.
critical_code_review_comments: Modules.css line 22: `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` is a common pitfall — does not produce equal columns when children have differing min-content widths. Prefer `repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))`.

Modules.css @media (max-width: 520px) {.modules__tabs { width: 100% }} forces the container to fill the viewport but does not address the underlying column-sizing pitfall; combined with `white-space: nowrap` on the tabs, this guarantees overflow once tab content exceeds 50% of viewport.

Consider extracting the equal-height stretch pattern (align-items: stretch + height: 100% on wrap/card) into a shared utility class — it is duplicated across Activities/Problem/Modules/Team CSS files (DRY violation).

rca_of_the_issue: Bug: At narrow viewports the .modules__tab-glider does not cover the active tab and tabs are unequal width. Reproduction: open http://localhost:3000/ at viewport 390x844, scroll to #modules — observe Phase 2 tab is visibly wider than Phase 1; the glider pill on Phase 1 leaves Phase 2's text uncovered; clicking Phase 2 leaves the glider too short on the right. Root cause: `.modules__tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr }` distributes only FREE (positive) space equally; when child intrinsic widths differ (caused by `.modules__tab { white-space: nowrap }` and the Phase 2 label being longer), the columns inherit the differing min-content sizes. The glider is sized `width: calc(50% - 6px)` of the container — correct only when columns are truly equal. Mitigation: use `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))` (the `minmax(0,1fr)` allows columns to shrink below content size, equalizing them) and pair with a strategy to prevent text overflow at the smallest viewports (allow wrapping, shorter label, or smaller font).
